name: @aeci/datatool
description: Internal admin Worker: clone D1 data env→env (full mirror) + seed reviews + reindex Algolia. Cloudflare-Access-gated. Manual deploy (not in CI).

scripts.dev: wrangler dev --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
